title.narrative: Support for strengthening the National Assisted Transport and Pre-Hospital Care Network in Peru

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to manage resources for strengthening the National Assisted Transport and Pre-Hospital Care Network in Peru through the procurement of 184 rural and urban ambulances, including 15 Type I urban ambulances, 7 Type II urban ambulances, 6 Type III urban ambulances, 76 Type I rural ambulances, and 80 Type II rural ambulances.
